contract_basis: m02-m03-code-v2 persistence requires malformed/oversized data handling and retained persistence regressions, with actual execution evidence required for acceptance.
BoundedFileReader documents reading only an opened regular file; final-component metadata preflight is advisory, and an opened descriptor must pass no-follow/type/size checks.
The reader does not promise an immutable snapshot or rejection of intermediate-directory symlinks; security scope and provider coordination belong to callers.

checks.case: Advisory metadata cannot authorize a changed path
checks.observation: rejectKnownNonRegularFile uses lstat and rejects known nonregular final components; read independently performs open and fstat without trusting prior pathname metadata.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review; tests not run.

checks.case: Final symlink and nonregular descriptor safety
checks.observation: Darwin.open uses O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK | O_CLOEXEC. ELOOP maps to notRegularFile. O_NONBLOCK permits a FIFO descriptor to be validated without waiting for a writer; fstat enforces S_IFREG before content reads.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review; tests not run.

checks.observation: FileHandle reads the descriptor obtained by open, and all subsequent metadata validation uses fstat on that descriptor. Replacing the pathname therefore does not redirect reads to replacement contents.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review; tests not run.

checks.case: Empty, exact-limit and initially oversized files
checks.observation: Descriptor size greater than maximumBytes is rejected before read-loop work; equal-size and empty files may reach EOF successfully. A one-byte EOF probe allows exact-limit files while rejecting an observed excess byte.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review; tests not run.

checks.observation: Every read is limited to min(65536, maximumBytes + 1 - contents.count), and an accumulated excess byte immediately raises tooLarge. A file that shrinks reaches EOF with its available bytes; no documented snapshot or minimum-size contract is violated by this behavior.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review; growth regression inspected but not run. Truncation analyzed from EOF control flow.

checks.case: Descriptor cleanup on success and failure
checks.observation: Immediately after a successful open, FileHandle owns the descriptor with closeOnDealloc: true and a defer invokes close. This covers fstat failure, invalid descriptor type, oversized metadata, oversized observed contents, read errors, and normal EOF return. Failed open produces no owned descriptor requiring close.
checks.result: No concrete defect found by control-flow review; no descriptor-leak runtime probe executed.
